sentences.s01: Application of the capsaicin 8 % patch is associated with treatment-related discomfort .
sentences.s02: Consequently , pretreatment for 60min with anaesthetic cream is recommended ; however , this may be uncomfortable and time consuming .
sentences.s03: We conducted a multicentre , randomized ( 1:1 ) , assessor-blinded study in patients with peripheral neuropathic pain to assess tolerability of the capsaicin patch following topical lidocaine ( 4 % ) or oral tramadol ( 50mg ) pretreatment .
sentences.s04: The primary endpoint was the proportion of patients tolerating capsaicin patch application ( ability to receive 90 % of a 60-min application ) .
sentences.s05: Numeric Pain Rating Scale ( NPRS ) scores were assessed before , during and after treatment .
sentences.s06: Overall , 122 patients were included ( 61 per arm ) .
sentences.s07: The capsaicin patch was tolerated by 121 patients .
sentences.s08: Tolerability of the capsaicin patch was similar following pretreatment with lidocaine and tramadol .
sentences.s09: Following patch application , pain levels increased up to 55min ( change from baseline of 1.3 for lidocaine and 1.4 for tramadol ) .
sentences.s10: After patch removal , tramadol-treated patients experienced greater pain relief up to the end of day 1 ; in the evening , mean changes in NPRS scores from baseline were 0 for lidocaine and -1 for tramadol .
sentences.s11: Proportions of patients reporting increases of 2 NPRS points or > 33 % from baseline at one or more time point ( s ) on the day of treatment were similar between arms .
sentences.s12: Adverse event incidence was comparable between arms .
sentences.s13: Capsaicin 8 % patch tolerability was similar in the two arms , with comparable results for most secondary endpoints .
sentences.s14: Tramadol given 30min before patch application should be considered as an alternative pretreatment option in patients receiving capsaicin patch treatment .

sentences.s01: In human beings , 5-HT6 receptors are almost exclusively expressed in the brain , particularly in areas relevant for cognition , such as the hippocampus and frontal cortex .
sentences.s02: We assessed the effect on cognitive performance of Lu AE58054 ( idalopirdine ) , a selective 5-HT6 receptor antagonist , in donepezil-treated patients with moderate Alzheimer 's disease .
sentences.s03: For this randomised , double-blind , placebo-controlled phase 2 trial ( LADDER ) , we recruited patients from 48 outpatient clinical sites in seven countries .
sentences.s04: Patients were 50 years or older , had moderate Alzheimer 's disease ( a mini-mental state examination score of 12-19 ) , and had been stably treated with donepezil 10 mg per day for 3 or more months .
sentences.s05: Using a computer-generated sequence , we randomly assigned patients ( 1:1 , stratified by site ) to receive either idalopirdine 90 mg per day ( 30 mg thrice daily ) or placebo .
sentences.s06: The primary endpoint was change from baseline in the 11-item Alzheimer 's Disease Assessment Scale-cognitive subscale ( ADAS-cog ) at week 24 .
sentences.s07: We analysed all efficacy endpoints in the full-analysis set ( modified intention-to-treat analysis ) .
sentences.s08: This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov , number NCT01019421 .
sentences.s09: Between Dec 8 , 2009 , and Dec 23 , 2011 , we randomly allocated 278 patients to treatment : 133 to placebo and 145 to idalopirdine .
sentences.s10: 132 patients in the placebo group and 140 in the experimental group were included in the final analysis .
sentences.s11: At week 24 , the change from baseline in ADAS-cog total score was +138 ( SD 053 ) in the placebo group and -077 ( 055 ) in the idalopirdine group ( treatment difference of -216 points , 95 % CI -362 to -069 ; p = 00040 ) .
sentences.s12: 25 patients ( seven taking placebo and 18 taking idalopirdine ) discontinued treatment because of adverse events , the difference between groups being mainly due to asymptomatic transient increases in transaminase concentrations in some idalopirdine-treated patients .
sentences.s13: The most common adverse events ( occurring in > 3 % of patients ) were increased - glutamyltransferase ( 14 [ 10 % ] patients in the idalopirdine group vs two [ 2 % ] in the placebo group ) , diarrhoea ( six [ 4 % ] vs nine [ 7 % ] ) , urinary tract infection ( three [ 2 % ] vs nine [ 7 % ] ) , fall ( three [ 2 % ] vs eight [ 6 % ] ) , increased alanine aminotransferase ( nine [ 6 % ] vs none ) , and benign prostatic hyperplasia ( two [ 5 % ] vs none ) .
sentences.s14: Serious adverse events were reported by 14 ( 10 % ) patients in the idalopirdine group and 13 ( 10 % ) patients in the placebo group .
sentences.s15: One death occurred in each treatment group , neither were regarded as being related to treatment .
sentences.s16: Idalopirdine improved cognitive function in donepezil-treated patients with moderate Alzheimer 's disease .
sentences.s17: Larger studies in a broader population of patients are ongoing to substantiate the effects reported here .

sentences.s01: Existing psychological therapies for bipolar disorders have been found to have mixed results , with a consensus that they provide a significant , but modest , effect on clinical outcomes .
sentences.s02: Typically , these approaches have focused on promoting strategies to prevent future relapse .
sentences.s03: An alternative treatment approach , termed ` Think Effectively About Mood Swings ' ( TEAMS ) addresses current symptoms , including subclinical hypomania , depression and anxiety , and promotes long-term recovery .
sentences.s04: Following the publication of a theoretical model , a range of research studies testing the model and a case series have demonstrated positive results .
sentences.s05: The current study reports the protocol of a feasibility randomized controlled trial to inform a future multi-centre trial .
sentences.s06: A target number of 84 patients with a diagnosis of bipolar I or II disorder , or bipolar disorder not-otherwise-specified are screened , allocated to a baseline assessment and randomized to either 16 sessions of TEAMS therapy plus treatment-as-usual ( TAU ) or TAU .
sentences.s07: Patients complete self-report inventories of depression , anxiety , recovery status and bipolar cognitions targeted by TEAMS .
sentences.s08: Assessments of diagnosis , bipolar symptoms , medication , access to services and quality of life are conducted by assessors blind to treatment condition at 3 , 6 , 12 and 18 months post-randomization .
sentences.s09: The main aim is to evaluate recruitment and retention of participants into both arms of the study , as well as adherence to therapy , to determine feasibility and acceptability .
sentences.s10: It is predicted that TEAMS plus TAU will reduce self-reported depression in comparison to TAU alone at six months post-randomization .
sentences.s11: The secondary hypotheses are that TEAMS will reduce the severity of hypomanic symptoms and anxiety , reduce bipolar cognitions , improve social functioning and promote recovery compared to TAU alone at post-treatment and follow-up .
sentences.s12: The study also incorporates semi-structured interviews about the experiences of previous treatment and the experience of TEAMS therapy that will be subject to qualitative analyses to inform future developments of the approach .
sentences.s13: The design will provide preliminary evidence of efficacy , feasibility , acceptability , uptake , attrition and barriers to treatment to design a definitive trial of this novel intervention compared to treatment as usual .
sentences.s14: This trial was registered with Current Controlled Trials ( ISRCTN83928726 ) on registered 25 July 2014 .

sentences.s01: The BRAF inhibitors vemurafenib and dabrafenib have shown efficacy as monotherapies in patients with previously untreated metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations .
sentences.s02: Combining dabrafenib and the MEK inhibitor trametinib , as compared with dabrafenib alone , enhanced antitumor activity in this population of patients .
sentences.s03: In this open-label , phase 3 trial , we randomly assigned 704 patients with metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600 mutation to receive either a combination of dabrafenib ( 150 mg twice daily ) and trametinib ( 2 mg once daily ) or vemurafenib ( 960 mg twice daily ) orally as first-line therapy .
sentences.s04: The primary end point was overall survival .
sentences.s05: At the preplanned interim overall survival analysis , which was performed after 77 % of the total number of expected events occurred , the overall survival rate at 12 months was 72 % ( 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] , 67 to 77 ) in the combination-therapy group and 65 % ( 95 % CI , 59 to 70 ) in the vemurafenib group ( hazard ratio for death in the combination-therapy group , 0.69 ; 95 % CI , 0.53 to 0.89 ; P = 0.005 ) .
sentences.s06: The prespecified interim stopping boundary was crossed , and the study was stopped for efficacy in July 2014 .
sentences.s07: Median progression-free survival was 11.4 months in the combination-therapy group and 7.3 months in the vemurafenib group ( hazard ratio , 0.56 ; 95 % CI , 0.46 to 0.69 ; P < 0.001 ) .
sentences.s08: The objective response rate was 64 % in the combination-therapy group and 51 % in the vemurafenib group ( P < 0.001 ) .
sentences.s09: Rates of severe adverse events and study-drug discontinuations were similar in the two groups .
sentences.s10: Cutaneous squamous-cell carcinoma and keratoacanthoma occurred in 1 % of patients in the combination-therapy group and 18 % of those in the vemurafenib group .
sentences.s11: Dabrafenib plus trametinib , as compared with vemurafenib monotherapy , significantly improved overall survival in previously untreated patients with metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations , without increased overall toxicity .
sentences.s12: ( Funded by GlaxoSmithKline ; ClinicalTrials.gov number , NCT01597908 . )

sentences.s01: Twenty vertically HIV-infected children , 6-16 years of age , with stable viral load control and CD4 + values above 400 cells/mm ( 3 ) .
sentences.s02: Ten subjects continued their ongoing antiretroviral treatment ( ART , Group A ) and 10 were immunized with a HIV-DNA vaccine in addition to their previous therapy ( ART and vaccine , Group B ) .
sentences.s03: The genetic vaccine represented HIV-1 subtypes A , B and C , encoded Env , Rev , Gag and RT and had no additional adjuvant .
sentences.s04: Immunizations took place at weeks 0 , 4 and 12 , with a boosting dose at week 36 .
sentences.s05: Monitoring was performed until week 60 and extended to week 96 .
sentences.s06: Safety data showed good tolerance of the vaccine .
sentences.s07: Adherence to ART remained high and persistent during the study and did not differ significantly between controls and vaccinees .
sentences.s08: Neither group experienced either virological failure or a decline of CD4 + counts from baseline .
sentences.s09: Higher HIV-specific cellular immune responses were noted transiently to Gag but not to other components of the vaccine .
sentences.s10: Lymphoproliferative responses to a virion antigen HIV-1 MN were higher in the vaccinees than in the controls ( p = 0.047 ) , whereas differences in reactivity to clade-specific Gag p24 , RT or Env did not reach significance .
sentences.s11: Compared to baseline , the percentage of HIV-specific CD8 + lymphocytes releasing perforin in the Group B was higher after the vaccination schedule had been completed ( p = 0.031 ) .
sentences.s12: No increased CD8 + perforin levels were observed in control Group A.
sentences.s13: The present study demonstrates the feasibility , safety and moderate immunogenicity of genetic vaccination in vertically HIV-infected children , paving the way for amplified immunotherapeutic approaches in the pediatric population .

sentences.s01: Depressive disorders are one of the leading components of the global burden of disease with a prevalence of up to 14 % in the general population .
sentences.s02: Numerous studies have demonstrated that pharmacotherapy combined with non-pharmacological measures offer the best treatment approach .
sentences.s03: Psycho-education as an intervention has been studied mostly in disorders such as schizophrenia and dementia , less so in depressive disorders .
sentences.s04: The present study aimed to assess the impact of psycho-education of patients and their caregivers on the outcome of depression .
sentences.s05: A total of 80 eligible depressed subjects were recruited and randomised into 2 groups .
sentences.s06: The study group involved an eligible family member and all were offered individual structured psycho-educational modules .
sentences.s07: Another group ( controls ) received routine counselling .
sentences.s08: The subjects in both groups also received routine pharmacotherapy and counselling from the treating clinician and were assessed at baseline , 2 , 4 , 8 , and 12 weeks using the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale ( HDRS ) , Global Assessment of Functioning ( GAF ) , and Psychological General Well-Being Index ( PGWBI ) .
sentences.s09: Results from both groups were compared using statistical methods including Chi-square test , Fisher 's exact test , Student 's t test , Pearson 's correlation coefficient , as well as univariate and multiple regression analyses .
sentences.s10: Baseline socio-demographic and assessment measures were similar in both groups .
sentences.s11: The study group had consistent improvement in terms of outcome measures with HDRS , GAF , and PGWBI scores showing respective mean change of -15.08 , 22 , and 60 over 12 weeks .
sentences.s12: The comparable respective changes in the controls were -8.77 , 18.1 , and 43.25 .
sentences.s13: Structured psycho-education combined with pharmacotherapy is an effective intervention for people with depressive disorders .
sentences.s14: Psycho-education optimises the pharmacological treatment of depression in terms of faster recovery , reduction in severity of depression , and improvement in subjective wellbeing and social functioning .

sentences.s01: We previously reported a randomized , sham-controlled trial of 5 Hz dorsolateral prefrontal left - and right-side repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation ( rTMS ) in 48 participants with a medically refractory major depressive disorder .
sentences.s02: Depression improved most with right-side cranial stimulation , both rTMS and sham , and to a lesser degree with left rTMS .
sentences.s03: Because depression is often associated with cognitive impairment , in this study we sought to determine whether our earlier participants had treatment-induced changes in cognition , which cognitive domains ( language , executive , visuospatial , verbal episodic memory , attention ) were affected , and whether treatment-induced cognitive changes were related either to improvement in depression or to other treatment variables , such as right versus left treatment and rTMS versus sham .
sentences.s04: We used hierarchical regression analyses to determine how variables measured at baseline or associated with treatment affected changes in neuropsychological functions .
sentences.s05: The variables were neuropsychological function in the 5 domains , severity of depression , change in depression with treatment , rTMS versus sham , laterality of stimulation , and rTMS-laterality interaction .
sentences.s06: Compared to sham , right rTMS was associated with 1.24 standard deviations greater gain in language function , 1.09 standard deviations greater gain in visuospatial function , and 2.38 standard deviations greater gain in verbal episodic memory than left rTMS .
sentences.s07: These improvements did not appear to be directly related to the relief from depression .
sentences.s08: Our results suggest that disorders of cognition and mood in depression may have different mechanisms , but right rTMS may treat both .
sentences.s09: We propose potential mechanisms underlying the right-side rTMS effect .
sentences.s10: Clinicaltrials.gov NCT00711568 .

sentences.s01: The management of patients suffering from opioid-refractory cancer pain with a neuropathic component remains an important challenge for healthcare workers .
sentences.s02: Only one retrospective study specifically reported the use of intravenous ( IV ) lidocaine amongst the palliative care unit population , the study found that there was a positive response to this therapy .
sentences.s03: These preliminary uncontrolled results need to be confirmed by randomized controlled trials .
sentences.s04: The primary objective of this study is to assess the analgesic efficacy of IV lidocaine in patients in palliative care suffering from opioid-refractory cancer pain with a neuropathic component .
sentences.s05: The secondary objectives are to assess the tolerance of , symptomatology , and patient satisfaction with the therapeutic approach .
sentences.s06: This will be a multicenter , prospective , randomized , placebo-controlled , double-blind , two-parallel group study .
sentences.s07: It will take place in eight adult palliative care units across France .
sentences.s08: The main inclusion criteria are as follows : adult patients suffering from opioid-refractory cancer pain with a neuropathic component , and those receiving palliative care as defined by French Society of Palliative and Support Care .
sentences.s09: Participants will be randomized ( 1:1 allocation ratio ) to one of two treatment groups : a ) lidocaine-experimental group ( intravenous lidocaine ) , or b ) placebo-control group ( intravenous saline solution ) .
sentences.s10: Evaluation assessments will be taken at baseline ( T0 randomization ) , 40 minutes ( T1 ) , 120 minutes ( T2 ) , 12 hours ( T3 ) , 24 hours ( T4 ) , 48 hours ( T5 ) , and 14 days ( T6 ) after baseline .
sentences.s11: The primary endpoint is change in the pain level between T0 and T1 .
sentences.s12: The secondary endpoints are : changes in the pain level between T0 and other times , intensity of the neuropathic pain component , daily opioid consumption , symptoms ( as classified by the MD Anderson Symptom Inventory ) , adverse events , and patient 's satisfaction ( measured using the Pain Treatment Satisfaction Scale ) .
sentences.s13: A sample size of 200 individuals will be needed to obtain 90 % power to detect a 25 % difference in pain success at T1 between the two groups ; pain success is classified as a 30 % decrease in the pain level between T0 and T1 ( 10 % of patients lost to follow-up expected ) .
sentences.s14: The randomized , double-blind , placebo-controlled design is the most appropriate design to demonstrate the efficacy of a new experimental intervention ( Evidence-Based Medicine Working Group classification ) .
sentences.s15: National and international recommendations could be updated based on the findings of this study .
sentences.s16: Current controlled trials NCT02137954 ( registration date : 7 May 2014 ) .

sentences.s01: Pneumonia is the leading cause of childhood mortality globally .
sentences.s02: Respiratory syncytial virus ( RSV ) is the most important viral cause of pneumonia .
sentences.s03: Maternal serum antibody protects infants from RSV disease .
sentences.s04: The objective of our study was to characterize RSV antibody levels in mother-infant pairs .
sentences.s05: Serial serum samples were collected from mother-infant pairs in Bangladesh from the third trimester of pregnancy to 72 weeks postpartum and tested using an RSV antibody microneutralization assay .
sentences.s06: Serologic infection was defined as a 4-fold increase in antibody titer .
sentences.s07: Maternal antibody half-life was calculated using infant antibody titers from birth to 20 weeks .
sentences.s08: The ratio of infant cord blood to maternal serum RSV antibody titers in 149 mother-infant pairs was 1.01 ( 95 % confidence interval [ CI ] , .99 -1.03 ) .
sentences.s09: Maternal RSV antibody titers in the third trimester and at birth were strongly correlated ( R = 0.68 ) .
sentences.s10: Antibody half-life was 38 days ( 95 % CI , 36-42 days ) .
sentences.s11: Higher cord blood RSV antibody titers were associated with a lower risk of serologic infection ( P = .01 ) and maintenance of antibody titer above a potentially protective threshold ( P < .001 ) .
sentences.s12: Efficient transplacental transfer of RSV-specific antibody from mother to the fetus was documented in mother-infant pairs in Asia .
sentences.s13: Higher cord blood antibody titers were associated with protection from serologic infection .

sentences.s01: Long-acting reversible contraceptive ( LARC ) methods , such as the intrauterine device and implant , are highly effective but used by less than 10 % of US women .
sentences.s02: The objective of our study was to improve LARC interest by enhancing clinic counseling .
sentences.s03: A quality improvement methodology was used to evaluate intrauterine device service delivery in 3 Chicago Title X clinics .
sentences.s04: To address identified barriers , we developed a theory-based iOS application ( app ) for patients to use in the clinic waiting room using human-centered design .
sentences.s05: The final prototype was tested in a randomized controlled trial in a Title X clinic with sexually active females ( 79 % African American ) under age 30 years .
sentences.s06: Our sample of 60 was chosen to detect an increase from 10 % ( baseline ) to 45 % ( app intervention ) in the proportion of patients expressing interest in discussing a LARC method during their clinic visit with 80 % power and two-sided = 0.05 .
sentences.s07: After completing demographic and baseline knowledge questionnaires , participants were randomized 1:1 to intervention ( app ) or standard care arms .
sentences.s08: App users also completed a posttest .
sentences.s09: Our primary outcome was expressed interest in discussing a LARC method during the clinic visit .
sentences.s10: Secondary outcomes were contraceptive knowledge and LARC selection .
sentences.s11: App testers ( n = 17 ) preferred interactive , visually appealing design and video testimonials .
sentences.s12: In the pilot randomized controlled trial ( n = 52 ) , app users had a significantly higher knowledge of contraceptive effectiveness ( P = .0001 ) and increased interest in the implant ( 7.1-32 .1 % , P = .02 ) after the intervention .
sentences.s13: Users were highly satisfied with the app .
sentences.s14: Staff reported no problems using the app in the clinic .
sentences.s15: Use of a theory-based counseling app offers a novel method to optimize wait time while minimizing clinic flow disruption .
sentences.s16: Preliminary data demonstrate that app use was associated with improvements in patients ' contraceptive knowledge and interest in the implant .

sentences.s01: To compare clerkship medical students ' confidence in performing a simulated normal vaginal delivery ( NVD ) after participating in a simulation training session using two different models .
sentences.s02: Medical students were randomized to participate in a simulated NVD session using either an obstetrics mannequin or a birthing pelvis model .
sentences.s03: Questionnaires were used to assess confidence and evaluate the simulation before and immediately after the session and on the last day of the obstetrics clerkship rotation .
sentences.s04: One hundred ten students were randomized .
sentences.s05: At the start of the clerkship , both groups had similar obstetrics exposure and confidence levels .
sentences.s06: Only 15 students ( 13.9 % ) agreed they were ready to attempt a NVD with minimal supervision or independently .
sentences.s07: This increased significantly to 43 students ( 39.4 % ) immediately after the session .
sentences.s08: At the end of the clerkship , 79 of 81 responding students ( 97.5 % ) were confident that they could attempt a NVD with minimal supervision or independently .
sentences.s09: There were no significant differences noted between simulator groups at any point .
sentences.s10: The sessions were rated as equally useful and realistic , and this remained unchanged at the end of the clerkship .
sentences.s11: Simulated NVD training using either an obstetrics mannequin or a birthing pelvis model provides clerkship students with a positive experience and increases confidence immediately .
sentences.s12: It should be implemented early in the rotation , as it appears the clerkship experience also plays a large role in terms of students ' confidence .
sentences.s13: Despite this , students maintain this type of learning is useful .
sentences.s14: Effective simulation training can easily be incorporated into clerkship training .

sentences.s01: Orbital inflammation is a potentially blinding and disfiguring disease process that is often treated with systemic corticosteroids and immunosuppression ; better treatments are needed .
sentences.s02: To determine whether rituximab , a monoclonal antibody against the B-lymphocyte antigen CD20 , is effective in the treatment of refractory orbital inflammation .
sentences.s03: A dose-ranging , randomized , double-masked phase 1/2 clinical trial was conducted at a tertiary referral ophthalmology clinic .
sentences.s04: Ten individuals with orbital inflammation refractory to systemic corticosteroids and at least 1 other immunosuppressive agent were enrolled from January 2007 to March 2010 .
sentences.s05: Rituximab infusions were administered on study days 1 and 15 at doses of either 500 mg or 1000 mg .
sentences.s06: Initial responders with recurrent inflammation after week 24 were permitted reinfusion with an additional cycle of 2 open-label 1000-mg rituximab infusions .
sentences.s07: The primary outcomes were reduction of inflammation measured with a validated orbital disease grading scale and corticosteroid dose reduction by at least 50 % .
sentences.s08: The secondary outcomes were visual acuity , reduction in pain , and participant - and physician-reported global health assessment .
sentences.s09: Of 10 enrolled patients , 7 demonstrated improvement on the orbital disease grading scale at the 24-week end point with rituximab therapy .
sentences.s10: Of these 7 individuals , 4 were receiving corticosteroids at study inception and all achieved successful dose reduction .
sentences.s11: For the secondary outcome measures in the 10 participants , 7 patients and 8 patients improved in self-rated and physician global health scores , respectively , and 7 patients had reduction in pain by 25 % or more at 24 weeks .
sentences.s12: Four patients who were positive responders at the week 24 end point experienced breakthrough inflammation after week 24 and received reinfusions between 24 and 48 weeks .
sentences.s13: Vision remained stable in all participants .
sentences.s14: Three of 10 patients had short-term objective or subjective worsening 2 to 8 weeks after receiving rituximab infusions , which was averted in subsequent patients with oral corticosteroids administered during the infusion and did not affect the eventual positive treatment outcome .
sentences.s15: No significant differences with regard to efficacy , toxicity , or likelihood of retreatment were noted between the dosing arms .
sentences.s16: Rituximab was safe and effective in 7 of 10 patients with noninfectious orbital disease , although 4 required reinfusion with rituximab to maintain control of orbital inflammation .
sentences.s18: Rituximab should be considered in the treatment of refractory orbital inflammation .

sentences.s01: It has not been examined trialed whether obsessive compulsive symptoms in patients with bipolar disorder respond to topiramate as an adjuvant treatment .
sentences.s02: This 4-month double-blind placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial examined the efficacy and safety of augmentation with topiramat for treating the patients with bipolar disorder , manic phase type-I , and obsessive compulsive disorder symptoms .
sentences.s03: Both groups received lithium + olanzapine + clonazepam .
sentences.s04: However , one group received topiramate and the other group placebo as adjuvant medications .
sentences.s05: Yale Brown obsessive compulsive behavior scale was used to assess the outcome .
sentences.s06: Adverse effects were also recorded .
sentences.s07: A total of 32 patients completed this trial .
sentences.s08: The mean score decreased from 24.2 ( 4.8 ) to 17.6 ( 8.7 ) in the topiramate group ( P < 0.003 ) and from 20.9 ( 2.9 ) to 9.6 ( 3.5 ) in the placebo group during this trial ( P < 0.0001 ) .
sentences.s09: Additionally , 9 ( 52.9 % ) out of 17 patients in the topiramate group and 2 ( 12.5 % ) out of 16 patients in the placebo group showed more than 34 % decline in YBOC score ( x2 = 6.0 , df = 1 , P < 0.01 ) .
sentences.s10: No serious adverse effects were detected .
sentences.s11: The limitations of the present study were its small sample size and the fact that it was conducted in a single center .
sentences.s12: The combination of lithium + olanzapine + clonazepam decreased the symptoms of obsessive compulsive disorder in the patients with bipolar disorder type I. However , topiramate had a more significant effect than placebo on improvement of the patients with bipolar disorder and obsessive compulsive symptoms .
sentences.s13: This combination seems to be without serious adverse effects .

sentences.s01: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of auto-crosslinked hyaluronic acid ( HA ) gel for preventing intrauterine adhesion ( IUA ) after hysteroscopic adhesiolysis .
sentences.s02: A prospective , randomized , double blinded and controlled clinical trial ( level I ) was performed .
sentences.s03: According to American Fertility Society ( AFS ) scoring system , 120 patients ( treatment group : 60 cases , control group : 60 cases ) with moderate to severe IUA were enrolled .
sentences.s04: Upon completion of adhesiolysis , a Foley balloon catheter was first introduced into the uterine cavity and then 3 ml of auto-crosslinked HA gel for patients in the treatment group ; patients in the control group , however , only received Foley balloon catheter .
sentences.s05: Second-look hysteroscopic examination was performed to all patients at 3 months postoperatively for evaluation of IUA .
sentences.s06: Primary endpoint was the reduction rate of IUA at 3 months after surgery .
sentences.s07: The secondary endpoints include total AFS score , score of each individual AFS category .
sentences.s08: At 3 months after surgery , auto-crosslinked HA gel resulted in significantly higher effective rate for reduction of adhesion , the effective rate were 76 % ( 42/55 ) and 48 % ( 27/56 ) respectively ( P = 0.000 9 ) ; the total AFS score of treatment group was 2.1 1.1 , and significantly lower than that of control group ( 3.7 2.5 , P = 0.000 8 ) .
sentences.s09: Application of auto-crosslinked HA gel after surgery significantly enhanced the improvement for each individual patient with regard to their adhesive type and menstrual pattern ( P = 0.037 8 , P = 0.000 4 ) .
sentences.s10: The treatment group had significantly lower proportion of patients with moderate to severe adhesive stages than that of control group [ 13 % ( 7/55 ) versus 38 % ( 21/56 ) , P = 0.000 6 ] .
sentences.s11: No adverse events and complications were observed .
sentences.s12: Auto-crosslinked HA gel coule be able to reduce IUA , decrease adhesion severity , and improve menopause postoperatively .
sentences.s13: This absorbable auto-crosslinked HA gel is proposed as a barrier for preventing IUA after intrauterine procedures .

sentences.s01: To evaluate the effect of oral supplementation with omega-3 ( -3 ) fatty acids ( FAs ) in improving contrast sensitivity ( CS ) of patients with moderate meibomian gland dysfunction ( MGD ) .
sentences.s02: In this prospective study , 60 patients with moderate MGD were allocated alternately to treatment and control groups .
sentences.s03: Both groups received warm compresses , lid massage , and artificial tear substitutes .
sentences.s04: The treatment group also received oral supplements of 1.2 g -3 FAs per day .
sentences.s05: All parameters were recorded at baseline and at 12 weeks and included Ocular Surface Disease Index scores , CS testing at 3 , 6 , 12 , and 18 cycles per degree ( cpd ) , tear break-up time , Schirmer test I without anesthesia , corneal and conjunctival staining scores , and meibum quality and expressibility .
sentences.s06: At the end of 12 weeks , significant improvement in CS was seen in the treatment group in 7 of the 8 testing conditions ( 3 , 6 , 12 , and 18 cpd photopic and 6 , 12 , and 18 cpd mesopic ) , whereas in the placebo group , significant improvement was seen only in 3 of the 8 testing conditions ( 3 cpd photopic , 6 and 18 cpd mesopic ) .
sentences.s07: Ocular Surface Disease Index , tear break-up time , ocular surface staining , and meibum quality and expressibility improved significantly in both groups , but more so in the treatment group .
sentences.s08: Schirmer scores showed no significant improvement in either group .
sentences.s09: Oral supplementation with -3 FAs significantly improved CS under both photopic and mesopic testing conditions in patients with moderate MGD .
sentences.s10: Tear film stability also improved significantly , whereas no effect was seen on aqueous tear production .

sentences.s01: Use of TIPSS is associated with increases in ammonia concentration and hepatic encephalopathy ( HE ) risk .
sentences.s02: L-ornithine-L-aspartate ( LOLA ) is effective in reducing ammonia concentration .
sentences.s03: To evaluate the effects of LOLA on venous ammonia concentration after TIPSS .
sentences.s04: The included patients were randomised to receive LOLA or no-LOLA treatment for 7 days .
sentences.s05: Fasting and post-prandial venous ammonia levels were the primary outcomes .
sentences.s06: Psychometric performance , post-TIPSS HE , and liver and renal function were assessed as secondary outcomes .
sentences.s07: Of 133 cirrhotic patients who received successful TIPSS between November 2011 and June 2012 , 40 met the inclusion criteria and were randomised to the LOLA ( n = 21 ) or control ( n = 19 ) groups .
sentences.s08: Change in fasting ammonia significantly favoured the LOLA group at days 4 ( P = 0.001 ) and 7 ( P = 0.003 ) .
sentences.s09: Changes in post-prandial ammonia concentration significantly favoured the LOLA group at days 1 , 4 and 7 as well .
sentences.s10: During the study period , patients in the LOLA group had better improvement in psychometric tests than those in the control group .
sentences.s11: Overt HE during treatment was observed in one patient in the LOLA group and three patients in the control group ( P = 0.331 ) .
sentences.s12: There were no differences in complications , adverse events or mortality between the two groups .
sentences.s13: Prophylactic use of LOLA infusion after TIPSS is safe and effective in significantly reducing the increase of venous ammonia concentration , and can benefit the patient 's mental status as well .

sentences.s01: Seasonal allergic rhinitis is typically poorly managed , particularly in adolescents , in whom it is responsible for considerable morbidity .
sentences.s02: Our previous work has demonstrated that if poorly controlled this can impair educational performance .
sentences.s03: The primary aim of this trial was to assess the impact of a primary care-based professional training intervention on clinical outcomes in adolescents with seasonal allergic rhinitis .
sentences.s04: Cluster trial in which UK general practice staff were randomised to a short , intensive workshop on the evidence-based management of seasonal allergic rhinitis .
sentences.s05: The primary outcome measure was the change in the validated Rhinoconjunctivitis Quality of Life Questionnaire with Standardized Activities ( RQLQ ( S ) ) score between baseline and 6 weeks post intervention ( minimal clinically important difference = 0.5 ) .
sentences.s06: Secondary outcome measures of interest included health-care professionals ' knowledge and confidence in managing seasonal allergic rhinitis , number of seasonal allergic rhinitis-related consultations , relevant treatments prescribed and symptom scores .
sentences.s07: Thirty-eight general practices were randomised ( 20 in the intervention arm ) and 246 patients ( 50.2 % males , mean age 15 years ) were included in the primary outcome analysis .
sentences.s08: Health-care professionals ' knowledge and confidence of the clinical management of seasonal allergic rhinitis improved .
sentences.s09: This did not , however , result in clinically or statistically significant improvements in RQLQ ( S ) : -0.15 , ( 95 % confidence interval , -0.5 to +0.2 ) .
sentences.s10: There were no differences in consultation frequency , treatments issued for seasonal allergic rhinitis or symptom scores .
sentences.s11: Although associated with increases in professionals ' self-assessed confidence and understanding of seasonal allergic rhinitis management , this intensive training workshop did not translate into improvements in adolescents ' disease-specific quality of life or a reduction in rhinitis symptoms .

sentences.s01: To assess the temporal patterns of late gastrointestinal ( GI ) and genitourinary ( GU ) radiotherapy toxicity and resolution rates in a randomised controlled trial ( All-Ireland Cooperative Oncology Research Group 97-01 ) assessing duration of neo-adjuvant ( NA ) hormone therapy for localised prostate cancer .
sentences.s02: Node negative patients with > 1 of : PSA > 20 ng/mL , Gleason score 7 , and stage T3 or more , were included .
sentences.s03: Follow-up , including toxicity assessment , was three-monthly in the early stages and yearly thereafter .
sentences.s04: Median follow-up from the end of RT was 6.8 years .
sentences.s05: In the interval between 90 days following the end of RT and the last toxicity assessment , GI and GU toxicity ( any grade ) was found in 50 % and 51 % of 240 and 241 patients , respectively .
sentences.s06: For those who did develop toxicity , the median time from end of RT until the first development of any grade GI or GU toxicity was 1.2 years and 1.6 years , respectively , whilst median time to final resolution was 1.6 years and 2.2 years , respectively .
sentences.s07: Grade 2 ( G2 ) or greater GI and GU toxicity occurred in 29 ( 12.1 % ) and 40 ( 16.6 % ) patients , respectively .
sentences.s08: The proportion with unresolved G2 + GI and GU toxicity was 89 % and 79 % , respectively , in year 1 , 69 % and 65 % in year 2 , 59 % and 52 % in year 3 and 27 % and 32 % in year 5 .
sentences.s09: Long-term toxicities continue to occur many years after NA hormone therapy and RT. .
sentences.s10: The rate of occurrence does not appear to reduce within the time frame during which our patients were followed .
sentences.s11: The percentage of patients suffering from G2 + toxicity at any time is however low .
sentences.s12: Resolution of these toxicities continues for the duration of the follow-up .

sentences.s01: Although women with substance use disorders ( SUDs ) have high rates of trauma and posttraumatic stress , many addiction programs do not offer trauma-specific treatments .
sentences.s02: One promising intervention is Pennebaker 's expressive writing , which involves daily , 20-minute writing sessions to facilitate disclosure of stressful experiences .
sentences.s03: Women ( N = 149 ) in residential treatment completed a randomized clinical trial comparing expressive writing with control writing .
sentences.s04: Repeated-measures analysis of variance was used to document change in psychological and physical distress from baseline to 2-week and 1-month follow-ups .
sentences.s05: Analyses also examined immediate levels of negative affect following expressive writing .
sentences.s06: Expressive writing participants showed greater reductions in posttraumatic symptom severity , depression , and anxiety scores , when compared with control writing participants at the 2-week follow-up .
sentences.s07: No group differences were found at the 1-month follow-up .
sentences.s08: Safety data were encouraging : although expressive writing participants showed increased negative affect immediately after each writing session , there were no differences in pre-writing negative affect scores between conditions the following day .
sentences.s09: By the final writing session , participants were able to write about traumatic/stressful events without having a spike in negative affect .
sentences.s10: Results suggest that expressive writing may be a brief , safe , low-cost , adjunct to SUD treatment that warrants further study as a strategy for addressing posttraumatic distress in substance-abusing women .

sentences.s01: The purpose of the present study was to assess the influence of electrode insertion length on cochlear implant ( CI ) performance .
sentences.s02: Prospective randomized allocation of CI patients to receive either a standard ( 26.4 mm ) - or medium ( 20.9 mm ) - length electrode array .
sentences.s03: The processing strategy and electrode insertion number were held constant .
sentences.s04: The postoperative testing audiologist was blinded to the map details and array .
sentences.s05: Tertiary referral center .
sentences.s06: Thirteen adult CI candidates randomized to receive the standard - ( n = 7 ) or medium-length ( n = 6 ) electrode array .
sentences.s07: Unilateral CI using standard - or medium-length array from the same implant system .
sentences.s08: Speech perception was assessed with HINT sentences in quiet and steady-state noise ( SNR , +10 ) and CNC words in quiet at defined intervals .
sentences.s09: Quality of life was assessed using the Hearing Device Satisfaction Survey and the Abbreviated Profile of Hearing Aid Benefit ( APHAB ) .
sentences.s10: Music perception was assessed using the Musical Sounds In Cochlear implants ( MuSIC ) test .
sentences.s11: Postoperative electrode insertion angle was assessed using reconstructed computed tomographic images .
sentences.s12: Interim analysis necessitated discontinuation of subject enrollment by the institutional review board .
sentences.s13: There was a trend ( p = 0.07 ) for improved speech perception performance among standard array patients .
sentences.s14: This difference was significant when the standard array group was increased retrospectively .
sentences.s15: Quality of life and music perception differences were not apparent between groups .
sentences.s16: Longer electrode insertions ( and greater insertion angles ) appear to offer better speech perception performance in the early postactivation period when using the same implant system .
